entries.zh: 每年一次为家族坟墓培土修缮（培墓、扫墓）
entries.en: to bank up and repair the family graves once a year
entries.notes: L 栏缩写残损（「ad10.… f[amili]es」），据 H「培墓」与 M/R 定为每年一次修培祖坟。

entries.zh: 翻整印板；整备印刷用的木板
entries.en: to set up and prepare the printing blocks (formes) of the press

entries.zh: 一汤三出：用同一锅汤分三次做出三道菜
entries.en: to dress three dishes in three rounds from one and the same broth

entries.zh: 猜谜；猜测
entries.en: to guess; to solve a riddle
entries.notes: M 栏附注 [muel coroh.] 未详，不害本义。

entries.zh: 猜看、猜一猜（猜测以求证是否果然）
entries.en: to guess in order to see whether it proves so

entries.zh: 猜中、猜对
entries.en: to guess and hit it; to guess rightly

entries.zh: 猜拳（以手指比数、猜单双的博戏）
entries.en: to play the finger-guessing game (morra); to guess odd or even

entries.zh: 猜枚（猜手中所握之物的单双、数目）
entries.en: to play the guessing game of odd or even, guessing the pieces held in the hand
entries.notes: L 栏语句残缺（「a que me le dia…」），据 H「謎枚」与 M/R 定为猜枚之戏。

entries.zh: 东猜西猜、胡乱揣度（如谵妄中）
entries.en: to guess wildly, now this now that, as in delirium

entries.zh: 猜中了（谜底揭出）
entries.en: guessed it and hit it; the riddle is solved

entries.zh: 仔细揣度、小心地猜
entries.en: to guess carefully, with deliberation

entries.zh: 约赌（嬉戏中相约打赌，以猜为赌）
entries.en: to lay a wager on a guess in play; to bet
entries.notes: L 作「aportando」，疑为「apostando」（下注）之讹；H 仅「约」一字，赌赛义据博戏语境推定。

entries.zh: 约拳（约定以猜拳赌输赢）
entries.en: to wager at finger-guessing (morra); to agree on a bout of morra
entries.notes: 「约」之赌赛义系据 L「ut a pares y nones」上下文推定。

entries.zh: 约定、议定（预先说定）
entries.en: to agree upon; to settle beforehand
entries.notes: L 栏夹注 [acertar] 与 H「约定」不合，今从 H 栏。

entries.zh: 占卜、卜问
entries.en: to divine; to practise divination

entries.zh: 卜卦、占问吉凶
entries.en: to divine by the hexagrams; to cast a divination

entries.zh: 料中、揣度而中（猜中）；料想
entries.en: to conjecture and hit upon; to guess rightly
entries.notes: H「詎」本为反诘虚词，M/R 音 cù/qūi 亦与官话 jù 不合；据与第 18 条「詎料」连类，取「料中」义。

entries.zh: 料中、料想得中
entries.en: to reckon and hit it; to have guessed rightly
entries.notes: 「詎料」为文言「岂料」套语，此处借「料」之揣度义。

entries.zh: 占（观察征兆以测吉凶）
entries.en: to divine by omens; to foretell

entries.zh: 占卜（以征兆问吉凶）
entries.en: to divine by lots and omens

entries.zh: 占台官（掌观象占候之官）；占卜师、预言者
entries.en: astrologer-official of the observation terrace; soothsayer, prophet
entries.notes: L 谓「人言国王即如是」语义支离，M 栏附注 [qui muel coroh.] 未详，故降置信。

entries.zh: 求签问卜（以竹签占吉凶）
entries.en: to divine by drawing lots (bamboo slips)
entries.notes: H 首字「完」于抽签义难通（M/R 作 vān/vân），据 L「por suertes」与「籤」字暂释。
